card.title: TYPE 97 SHINHOTO
card.flavorText: The Type 97 Shinhoto Chi-Ha was a Japanese medium tank that was used during WWII and was considered one of the best Japanese tanks to be used in the Pacific War. The tank was an upgraded version of the Type 97 Chi-Ha medium tank. It used a Type 97 Chi-Ha hull, but came with a larger three man turret that was armed with a high-velocity 47 mm gun instead of the 57 mm gun. Around 930 Type 97 Shinhoto were produced and quite a few of them were converted Type 97 Chi-Ha tanks. The tank had a crew of 5 (Commander, gunner, loader, bow gunner, driver) and a secondary armament of 2 x 7.7 mm Type 97 machine guns.
